listing.name: White Knight Chronicles I (included in II edition) — WhiteKnightChronicles2Recomp (WK2D)
listing.summary: The project reports WKC I’s starting town at 30 FPS, short movement, pause, saving, Continue and a short transition to Balastor Plain. Sustained combat has not been confirmed. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own White Knight Chronicles II edition disc. This guide does not specify the exact serial number or required update; check the project’s requirements before setup.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Build locally from source and follow the project’s native-player launch instructions.
